title: TENANT.theme_tokens
description: Backend contract for the theme_tokens JSON stored per tenant and served by the tenant config & theming service. Clients cache this offline and fall back to the in-binary ECD Connect theme when absent. Structure mirrors design-system/tokens/tokens.json: a `palette` of raw hues, plus `roles` that POINT AT palette keys. Status colours, developmental-domain colours, the type scale, spacing, radii and component anatomy are NOT part of this schema — they are platform constants and must never be themed.

model.description: OA = Open Access (default tenant), WL = White Label.

palette.description: The tenant's raw brand hues. A tenant need not supply all five hue families, but every palette key referenced by `roles` or `categoryMapping` MUST exist here.

roles.description: Maps each semantic role to a KEY in `palette`. This indirection is the white-label seam: components reference roles only, so a tenant re-points roles without any code change. Every value must be a key present in `palette`.

scrim.description: Modal scrim, expressed as a palette hue plus alpha so clients can composite it correctly. Defaults to primary @ 0.7.

categoryMapping.description: Content-category → palette key. The client derives the card tint from the matching *Accent2 of the same hue family.

logoColour.description: SVG logo mark in brand colour, for white surfaces.

logoWhite.description: SVG logo mark in white, for the navy app bar and coloured surfaces.

graphicOverlays.description: Tonal header overlays. Heights are fixed by the design; supply the sizes the tenant's screens use.

mascotPack.description: Identifier for the animoji/mascot set. Slots are fixed; only the artwork changes.

paletteKey.description: Must be a key present in this theme's `palette` object.
